chapter: Chicago and New York with Louis Armstrong, 1925-30
title: Joining Carroll Dickerson's band and coming to New York
summary: After the Warwick flop Zutty went into the Apex, then the Savoy with Carroll Dickerson's band featuring Louis, and they came to New York together, a stint of almost two years.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So what did you do when that flopped on you?
Oh, I see. Oh I see, yes. Then joined CARROLL .... featuring Louis Armstrong. Yes.

Then I had got a job at the Apex. See, after this thing flopped with Louis and Father Hines deal with L'il Louis Armstrong, that's when I went into the Apex. And that's when we got involved with Carroll (Car Dickerson) at the Savoy. Carroll
How long did that run with (Car Dickerson)?
Oh that was, we came to New York together.
Yes, that last about, almost two years.
